reason: Document A states facts accurately and admits the cost most likely to worry us: in 2027, ad revenue stops in January while membership income builds slowly. That candour is what would win over the two of us from advertising and sales. Document B says ads fell 36% "in a single year", but the drop was over two years. That error inflates its projected decline, and B never mentions the first-year revenue gap, so the sales-minded board members would catch both and stop trusting the rest of the memo.
